verdict.rationale: Google Voice is a SaaS telephony product with AI features such as AI-assisted note-taking and voicemail transcription, so a control over AI training on user data is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an opt-out from AI model training or any data-use policy for training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
